subject: Post-call recap & routing plan — decision roster and contract sequencing (HealthGrid pilot)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap & routing plan — decision roster and contract sequencing (HealthGrid pilot)

Thanks again for your time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we can make contracting efficient. Short version up top: identify econ buyer + legal/procurement owners, execute NDA, collect security artifacts, then proceed to DPA/MSA redlines.

Recap from the call:
- Primary pilot use case: realtime summarization of clinician notes (no PHI in pilot).
- Expected monthly volume: ~8M tokens for 3-month pilot.
- Success criteria: latency < 250ms p95 on sample routes; inference cost < $0.006/token at scale; security checklist satisfied for non-PHI pilot.

Ask / proposed routing:
1) Confirm economic buyer and named legal/procurement contacts (we can pre-seed forms).
2) NDA first (DocuSign OK) — we’ll use our short mutual NDA to unblock exchanges.
3) Security evidence (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram) + DPA conversation in parallel.
4) MSA redline sequencing after core controls agreed (target window: 10–20 business days depending on redlines).

Proposed internal owners (happy to reassign):
- Commercial lead / econ buyer liaison: Marcus Lin (me)
- Pricing & procurement lead: Ben Carter
- Security / questionnaire owner: Neha Kapoor

Attachments: redwood-pilot-deck.pdf (demo + SOW sketch).

Next steps: can you confirm: (a) who is the econ buyer, (b) who will sign the NDA, (c) who owns procurement/security reviews? If helpful I can propose a short mutual action plan with dates.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & routing plan — decision roster and contract sequencing (HealthGrid pilot)

Thanks Laura — that mapping helps a lot. I've sketched a concrete routing plan below for your review and tightened the turn-time expectations so everyone has clarity.

Routing proposal (sequence + owners + targets):
1) Mutual NDA (DocuSign) — primary signer: Karen Liu. Owner: Marcus Lin (send). Target: 1–3 business days.
2) Security intake & SOC2 evidence — owner: Neha Kapoor (I’ll introduce). Target: gather artifacts within 7 business days after NDA execution.
3) DPA conversation (data residency, retention terms) — owner: Neha + Sarah O'Neill. Target: 7–14 business days (parallel with security intake).
4) MSA redline -> commercial terms (pricing, SLAs) — owner: Ben Carter (pricing) + Marcus (commercial). Target: initial redline window 10–14 business days; quick clarifications within 3–5 days.

We will attach the following to the DocuSign flow: MSA-template-redwood-v1.docx (our starting point) and a short SOW sketch. To keep the pilot narrow and quick, we recommend: limited dataset, non-PHI pilot, 3-month term, auto-terminate if controls not met.

DocuSign link (NDA): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/NDA-HealthGrid-Redwood
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HG-2026-038

Ben / Neha — can you confirm you're comfortable with the owner assignments and the target SLAs above? If yes I’ll send the NDA to Karen and copy procurement.

Best,
Marcus

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Quick internal note — I'm good to own evidence collection and DPA negotiation. A few operational details for the intake so we don't get ping-ponged:
- SOC2: we have a redacted SOC2 Type II summary and control matrix; I'll prepare a one-page artifact pack (SOC2-summary.xlsx) and a short narrative on shared controls.
- Data flow diagram: will produce a single-slide DFD that shows no PHI in pilot and where telemetry lands.
- Questionnaire: ask HealthGrid to forward their security questionnaire to security@healthgrid.com and cc me; if they prefer a spreadsheet I will pre-populate answers where possible.
- Escalation: if procurement asks for stand-up SLA changes, Ben will lead commercial response and I will provide control mitigations.

Turn times I can commit to once NDA executed: 7 business days for artifact pack + initial DPA comments. If we see DPA redlines that touch data residency we should flag to Marcus + legal.

I'll draft the artifact pack and post to the HubSpot deal in a private folder.

Neha
